teaser.en: Its ribbon leaves can grow a metre long, streaming in the tide like green tape in the shallow lagoons.
teaser.sw: Majani yake kama riboni yanaweza kufikia urefu wa mita moja, yakielea na maji kama utepe wa kijani katika mahori yasiyo na kina.
teaser.dg: Makodzage dza utepe ganaweza kukala mare mita mwenga, na ganasumba kpwa madzi ga bahari dza utepe wa chijani, kpwenye madzi machache.

summary.en: Tape seagrass is the largest seagrass on the coast, with long ribbon leaves up to a metre long, and one of the predominant seagrasses in Kenya. Its meadows in sheltered lagoons are nurseries for the fish that Digo fishers catch.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari hii ya utepe (*tape seagrass*) ndiyo nyasi bahari kubwa zaidi pwani, yenye majani marefu kama riboni yanayofikia hadi mita moja, na ni mojawapo ya nyasi bahari zinazotawala nchini Kenya. Mbuga zake katika mahori yaliyokingwa ni malezi ya samaki wanaovuliwa na wavuvi wa Kidigo.
summary.dg: *Tape seagrass* ni nyasi kulu kuriko zosi za bahari pwani, yenye makodza mare dza utepe, hadi mita mwenga, na ni mwenga kahi ya nyasi za bahari zinazophahikana zaidi Kenya. Phatu phenye nyasi hizi kpwenye madzi machache garigo rindwa ni phepho ni phatu pha kukulira ng'onda ambao avuvi a Chidigo anaagbwira.

about.en:
Tape seagrass is a flowering plant that lives fully submerged in the sea. It is the giant among seagrasses: its long, flat ribbon leaves can reach a metre in length, rising from a thick, creeping stem covered in tough black fibres from old leaves.

At low tide the leaves lie flat on the water's surface. Its pollination is unusual: tiny male flowers break free and float on the surface to reach the female flowers.
about.sw:
Nyasi bahari ya utepe ni mmea unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa baharini. Ndiye jitu miongoni mwa nyasi bahari: majani yake marefu, bapa kama riboni yanaweza kufikia urefu wa mita moja, yakiinuka kutoka kwenye shina nene linalotambaa lililofunikwa na nyuzi ngumu nyeusi za majani ya zamani.

Wakati wa maji kupwa, majani hulala bapa juu ya uso wa maji. Uchavushaji wake si wa kawaida: maua madogo sana ya kiume hujinasua na kuelea juu ya uso wa maji ili kuyafikia maua ya kike.
about.dg:
*Tape seagrass* ni mmea wenye maruwa unaokala ndani ya bahari kabisa. Ni nyasi kulu kuriko zosi za bahari: makodzage mare na sambamba dza utepe ganaweza kufika mita mwenga, na ganamera kula kpwa muhi mkulu unaoambala, uriofwinikpwa ni nyuzi ngumu nyiru za makodza makare.

Wakati wa madzi ga kala, makodza ganalala sambamba dzulu ya madzi. Namna inavyophaha tembe ni ya ajabu: maruwa madide malume ganadoka na kuelea dzulu ya madzi hadi ganafika kpwa maruwa ga chichetu.

where.en: It grows in shallow, sheltered lagoons with muddy sand and is one of the predominant seagrasses in Kenya. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. Look for its long ribbons lying on the surface of the lagoon at low tide.
where.sw: Huota katika mahori yasiyo na kina, yaliyokingwa, yenye mchanga wa tope, na ni mojawapo ya nyasi bahari zinazotawala nchini Kenya. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Utaziona riboni zake ndefu zikilala juu ya uso wa maji ya mahori wakati wa maji kupwa.
where.dg: Inamera kpwenye madzi machache garigo rindwa ni phepho, phatu penye matope na mtsanga, na ni mwenga kahi ya nyasi za bahari zinazophahikana zaidi Kenya. Nyasi za bahari zinazunguluka kanda-kanda ya Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Lola makodzage mare dza utepe ganayolala dzulu ya madzi wakati wa madzi ga kala.

uses.en: Its meadows are habitat for the rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers that Digo fishers depend on. They also trap sediment and help to protect beaches.
uses.sw: Mbuga zake ni makazi ya tafi, pono, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea. Pia hunasa mashapo na kusaidia kulinda fukwe.
uses.dg: Phatu phenye nyasi hizi ni makalo ga tsafi, phono, pweza na majongoo ga bahari ambao avuvi a Chidigo anaakuluphira. Piya zinagbwira mtsanga na ulongo unaohalwa ni madzi, na zinaterya kurinda ufuwo.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili speakers usually call sea plants in general *mwani*. In English it is tape seagrass, and its scientific name is *Enhalus acoroides*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kwa kawaida huita mimea ya baharini kwa jumla *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *tape seagrass*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Enhalus acoroides*.
names.dg: Takuna dzina ra Chidigo ririroandikpwa hadi sambi. Atu anaogomba Chiswahili kpwa kawaida anaiha mimea yosi ya bahari *mwani*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *tape seagrass*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Enhalus acoroides*.

conservation.en: The seagrass meadows of Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni are feeding grounds for dugongs, green turtles and rabbitfish, and nurseries for young fish.
conservation.sw: Mbuga za nyasi bahari za Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni malisho ya nguva, kasa na tafi, na malezi ya samaki wachanga.
conservation.dg: Nyasi za bahari za Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni phatu pha kurya pha nguva, kasa a chijani na tsafi, na ni phatu pha kukulira ng'onda adide.
